faq: Do I need the Sleek Bundles app?
Yes, the offers run on Sleek Bundles. We install and set it up for you. You pay the app plan directly on Shopify and can see the current plan prices in the app listing before you start.
Will bundles change my product prices?
No. Your regular prices stay as they are. The app applies the bundle discount at the cart and checkout, and we test a full order so you can see the discount before anything goes live.
Can you pick which products to bundle?
Yes. We look at your best sellers and the products often bought together, then suggest pairs and tiers. You approve the list before we build it, and you can change it later in the app.
A staff or collaborator invite to your Shopify admin. We never ask for your password. You can remove our access whenever you like once the work is approved.
